fix: Removed the straight/square edges that appeared around the cards on mobile. Root cause: the mobile page-darkening overlay (.page::before) only darkened the top and bottom of the page (its middle was just 6% opaque), so the bright fireworks page background bled around the cards in hard-edged rectangles - made more obvious by the brighter V153 card glow. V154 darkens that overlay uniformly (74-94% across the full height) so every card sits on a clean dark backdrop and its rounded glow reads correctly with no square edges. The fireworks background is kept but subdued, matching the earlier dark mobile look.

verification.mobile_390_square_edges: gone (cards on clean dark backdrop, rounded glows intact)

note: Card glow, border, titles, timeline, and all V151-V153 mobile fixes are unchanged. Only the mobile background overlay was darkened.
